name: BlockCypher API (BTC, LTC, DOGE, DASH)
tier_rationale: BlockCypher Inc., an established company with published documentation, terms and paid plans (A8 trusted). Registry tiers: Blockstream, Blockchain.com, BlockCypher and Blockchair trusted; mempool.space and litecoinspace community.

reliability.justification: Explorer API with one schema for four UTXO chains: balances and transactions are chain facts.

blockcypher.description: BlockCypher API token (optional: raises the keyless 3 req/s, 100 req/h per IP limit)
blockcypher.plan_hint: business = a BlockCypher plan whose terms allow company use, recorded with `v3lum keys set blockcypher --plan business`; keyless use runs under corporate only once legal records free_plan_business_use

api.title: BlockCypher address endpoints /v1/{ltc,doge,dash,btc}/main/addrs/{a}[/full] and chain tips /v1/{coin}/main

terms.quote: Per-adapter terms recorded: Esplora, mempool, litecoinspace and Blockchain.com 'open'; BlockCypher and Blockchair 'key-terms'.

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P211 cond 2 and 6: 'BlockCypher (LTC/DOGE/DASH; optional token 'blockcypher', sent only after AR01 redaction)'). Research C0483 (verified_live 200): keyless 3 req/s and 100 req/h per IP (documented), token raises limits; invalid address -> 400 {'error': '... non-matching checksum.'}; /full paginates with before=<height> while hasMore. free_plan_business_use null: legal has not recorded whether keyless/free use allows company use, so under the corporate profile this source runs only with key_plans.blockcypher='business'. The token travels as ?token= (a key-like query parameter, redacted by AR01). Used by btc_explorers.
api.licensed_alternative: A BlockCypher plan recorded as key_plans.blockcypher='business'; litecoinspace.org (open) keeps LTC coverage, DOGE/DASH then need Blockchair with its commercial key.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G09-2 (P211). Quota block from the documented keyless limits (3 req/s, 100 req/h per egress IP; 80 % safety margin). The header x-ratelimit-remaining is not a usable countdown (always 1 in the prep live check).
